lines.text: They're always sitting at this table. All day, every day...
lines.zh: 他们总是坐在这张桌旁，日复一日……

lines.text: There isn't much going on in our caves at the moment so they don't have much to talk about.
lines.zh: 眼下我们的洞穴里没什么动静，所以他们也没多少可聊的。

lines.text: Most of their time is spent trying to decide who is going to be the next king.
lines.zh: 他们大部分时间都在设法决定下一任国王由谁来当。

lines.text: And then once they have decided on a new king he gets bored and names another new king almost instantly.
lines.zh: 可他们刚选出新国王，他转眼就会觉得无聊，几乎立刻又任命一位新国王。
